model.name: Online Boutique — Canonical Purchase-Path Scenario

state_meaning.frontend: x=1 iff the storefront browse path (home page: currencies, product list, cart) can render. RIPPLECUT-MODELED definition.
state_meaning.checkoutservice: x=1 iff PlaceOrder can complete. RIPPLECUT-MODELED definition.
state_meaning.other services: x=1 iff the service is UP (available).

excluded_from_model: redis-cart: backing store of cartservice (kubernetes-manifests/cartservice.yaml); not one of the 11 frozen services.
shoppingassistantservice: optional component (kustomize/components/shopping-assistant); not one of the 11 frozen services.
model.labeling: Every call edge is labeled SOURCE-BACKED with a file/line reference at the inspected commit. Every Boolean rule is RIPPLECUT-MODELED: it is informed by the source's error handling but is NOT claimed to be Online Boutique production semantics.

services.name: loadgenerator
services.description: Locust traffic generator (traffic infrastructure, not a business service).

excluded_services.reason: Backing store of cartservice (kubernetes-manifests/cartservice.yaml); not one of the 11 frozen services.
Optional component (kustomize/components/shopping-assistant); not one of the 11 frozen services.

dependency_rules.notes: x_checkout = x_cart AND x_catalog AND x_currency AND x_shipping AND x_payment. emailservice is SOFT because PlaceOrder only logs a warning when the confirmation email fails.

src/checkoutservice/main.go L339-347: prepOrderItems -> ProductCatalogService.GetProduct; error aborts PlaceOrder.
src/checkoutservice/main.go L348-351, L359-363: convertCurrency -> CurrencyService.Convert for item prices and shipping cost; error aborts PlaceOrder.
src/checkoutservice/main.go L313-318 (GetQuote) and L386-390 (ShipOrder); errors abort PlaceOrder (L258-261).
src/checkoutservice/main.go L369-373: chargeCard -> PaymentService.Charge; error aborts PlaceOrder (L252-255).
src/checkoutservice/main.go L273-274, L379-380: SendOrderConfirmation error is only logged (log.Warnf); the order still succeeds.

dependency_rules.notes: x_frontend models the storefront browse path (home page). Calls whose failure only breaks a specific page (cart view, checkout) or is logged and ignored are SOFT for this definition; the purchase path itself is represented by checkoutservice.

src/frontend/handlers.go L62-65 and L84-87 (getCurrencies / convertCurrency -> HTTP 500 on error); src/frontend/rpc.go L30-31, L77-81.
src/frontend/handlers.go L72-75 (homeHandler getCart -> HTTP 500 on error); src/frontend/rpc.go L57-58.
src/frontend/handlers.go L527-530: chooseAd logs a warning and returns nil on error.
src/frontend/handlers.go L178-180, L266-268 (warning only) and L378 (error ignored).

criticality.note: RippleCut policy choice for the purchase-flow demo, not a claim by Google about business importance (PDF §4.2).

interventions.name: Fail over payments to a modeled fallback path
interventions.description: Route PaymentService.Charge to a hypothetical fallback payment path. Modeled effect: paymentservice becomes UP.

interventions.name: Fail over shipping to a modeled fallback path
interventions.description: Route shipping quote/ship calls to a hypothetical fallback path. Modeled effect: shippingservice becomes UP.

interventions.name: Switch checkout backends to a modeled standby deployment
interventions.description: Point checkout's payment and shipping calls at a hypothetical standby deployment. Modeled effect: paymentservice and shippingservice become UP.

interventions.name: Restore product catalog from a modeled standby replica
interventions.description: Serve catalog reads from a hypothetical standby replica. Modeled effect: productcatalogservice becomes UP.

interventions.name: Restore currency conversion from a modeled standby replica
interventions.description: Serve conversions from a hypothetical standby replica. Modeled effect: currencyservice becomes UP.

interventions.name: Restart checkoutservice
interventions.description: Modeled effect: checkoutservice becomes UP. It stays UP only if its modeled dependencies are UP (the cascade re-runs after every intervention).

action_conflicts.rationale: Both redirect payment traffic; the model defines no composition, so the combination is rejected before simulation.
Both redirect shipping traffic; the model defines no composition, so the combination is rejected before simulation.

state_estimation.note: Thresholds are RippleCut configuration parameters, not learned or universal values (PDF §3.2).

presentation.note: UI layout only; has no effect on the model.
